standard_prerequisites.name: Pushforward and restriction formula
standard_prerequisites.use: Describes R^i f_* F as a sheafification of stalkwise cohomology.

standard_prerequisites.name: Smooth covering computes cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Spectral sequence used twice to reduce the stack to a scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology of parasitic modules on schemes

core_obligations: Reduction (2) => (1): by the cited pushforward-restriction lemma R^i f_* F is the sheaf associated to y |-> H^i(V x_y X, pr^{-1}F); pr is flat as a base change so pr^{-1}F is parasitic by lemma-parasitic(1); it suffices to prove (1) (proof lines 1508-1522).

Spectral sequence reduction: the smooth-covering spectral sequence reduces (1) to algebraic-space-representable X; each f_p^*F stays parasitic since the Cech terms f_p are flat; reusing the spectral sequence reduces to X representable by a scheme (proof lines 1525-1540).
Scheme case: H^i((Sch/X)_tau, F) = 0 by the cited Descent lemma on cohomology of parasitic modules (Cech covering argument) (proof lines 1540-1543).
proof_roadmap: Reduce statement (2) to statement (1) with the pushforward-restriction formula.
Prove (1) by two rounds of the smooth-covering spectral sequence plus the Descent lemma in the scheme case.
difficulty_reason: Two-stage reduction: (2) is reduced to (1) via the presheaf formula for higher pushforwards and flatness of the base-changed projection; (1) is proved by running the smooth-covering spectral sequence twice (stack to algebraic space to scheme) with flatness of the Cech terms keeping the pulled-back modules parasitic, the scheme case being covered by the cited Descent lemma on Cech cohomology of parasitic modules.
